title: Playboy Book of Lingerie Magazine Lot of 4 1990 1991 + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage magazines in good overall condition for their age. Covers show normal shelf, storage and handling wear, including some edge/corner wear and light surface wear. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as pictured.

Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy special-edition magazines from 1990 and 1991.

Includes:

* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — May/June 1990 — “The Joy of Sexy Intimate Apparel”
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — September/October 1991 — “Falling in Love With Intimate Apparel”
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — November/December 1991 — “All Wrapped Up in Intimate Apparel”
* Playboy’s Bathing Beauties — “Preview of Summer Sizzle”

All four magazines pictured are included and sold together as one lot.

Nice group of early-1990s Playboy special editions, including three Book of Lingerie issues and one Bathing Beauties issue.

Vintage pre-owned magazines may have age-related shelf, storage and handling wear. Please use the photos as the primary reference for condition and exactly what is included.

Quantity: 4 magazines
Publisher: Playboy
Era: 1990–1991
Format: Magazine / Special Edition
Language: English
Sale: Lot of 4 + 1
